title: A Space owner or admin can refund a shop order, a ticket or a donation from the Orders tab

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-27 (project thread: Trace the House of Fates payment); audit /mnt/project-files/payments-audit/PAYMENTS-ORDERS-TICKETS-AUDIT-2026-11-27.md

detail:
Owner ask 2026-11-27: 'We should be able to easily manage and track' payments and orders. Before: the Orders tab listed sales and offered nothing to do with them. A ticket could be refunded only from the event page, a shop order only by Frequency staff (refundCommerceOrder had one caller, the admin marketplace), and a donation had no refund path in the product at all.

DONE 2026-11-27: every sale that stands on the Orders tab carries a two-tap Refund. lib/commerce/space-refunds.ts pins the sale to the Space (the order's owner_space_id, the ticket's event by the same host rule the list uses, the donation's space_id) and then runs the money path that already exists for that kind; refundSpaceDonation is new and unwinds the destination charge the way a ticket refund does. The action is held to the owner or a Space admin (an editor is refused). A split order that pays other sellers too is refused and stays with staff. Full refunds only. No migration.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
